_readme: Clip Importer translations, shared by the macOS and Windows apps. Keys are the English text; {0}, {1} are values inserted by the app. Optional plural variants: "key#one", "key#few", "key#many", "key#other" (CLDR rules). To add a language, add its code to 'languages' and a block to 'translations'. Pull requests welcome!
